what_this_is: Every RED (scene, viewport) in the last recorded screenshot sweep must appear here,
filed under a defect id that exists in docs/DEFECTS.md. `./scripts/dev.sh shots-verdict`
-- which `make hygiene` runs -- fails on any red that is NOT listed, and equally on any
entry here that is no longer red.
WHY IT EXISTS. The pixel gate caught a real regression at 4af6dc6 (docs/DEFECTS.md E-63:
8.7% of a money figure covered by the felt) and NOBODY ACTED, for a whole wave. It was not
hidden: the sweep exited 1 and wrote it into the manifest. It was unreachable -- the only
thing that could see it was a sweep that needed a live replica, and the replica was down,
so no gate anyone could run was red and the finding sat in an artifact. This file makes
the LAST RECORDED VERDICT itself a gate: writing a red down is the only way past it, and
writing it down means filing a defect.
IT IS NOT A WAIVER LIST. An entry does not make a red acceptable; it makes it ACKNOWLEDGED.
The stale check is what keeps that honest: the moment a sweep comes back green for one of
these, its entry here fails the gate until it is deleted. docs/DEFECTS.md HARD RULE 7 --
a marker that pins a fixed defect is worse than no marker.
